how.en: Mix baking soda with a little white hair conditioner until it holds a snowball shape. Feel how cool it is, then build a tiny snowman.
how.hr: Pomiješajte sodu bikarbonu s malo bijelog regeneratora za kosu dok se ne da oblikovati u grudu. Osjetite koliko je hladan pa napravite malenog snjegovića.

how.en: Cut tiny snowflakes from tissue paper. Rub a balloon on your hair, hold it above them and watch them jump up and dance.
how.hr: Izrežite sitne pahuljice od tankog papira. Protrljajte balon o kosu, držite ga iznad njih i gledajte kako skaču i plešu.

how.en: Fold a square of paper into six sections instead of eight, then cut and unfold. Real snowflakes always have six arms.
how.hr: Presavijte kvadrat papira na šest dijelova umjesto na osam pa režite i rastvorite. Prave pahulje uvijek imaju šest krakova.

how.en: Stick a chocolate chip to a metal, a wooden and a plastic spoon with a dab of butter. Stand them in hot chocolate: whose chip slides off first?
how.hr: Komadićem maslaca zalijepite čokoladnu kapljicu na metalnu, drvenu i plastičnu žličicu. Stavite ih u toplu čokoladu: čija će kapljica prva skliznuti?

how.en: Mix flour, salt and water, roll the dough out and cut stars, hearts and trees. Bake them low and slow, or let them air-dry.
how.hr: Zamijesite brašno, sol i vodu, razvaljajte tijesto i izrežite zvijezde, srca i borove. Polako ih sušite u pećnici na niskoj temperaturi ili na zraku.

how.en: Paint yesterday's ornaments, thread a ribbon through the hole and seal them so damp air can't soften them.
how.hr: Obojite jučerašnje ukrase, provucite vrpcu kroz rupicu i premažite ih lakom da ih vlaga iz zraka ne omekša.

title.hr: Snjegović koji se pjeni i topi

how.en: Build a snowman from fake snow, then drip vinegar on it. It fizzes, melts away and even gets a little colder.
how.hr: Od umjetnog snijega napravite snjegovića pa ga pokapajte octom. Pjeni se, topi i čak se malo ohladi.

how.en: Make Möbius loops from red, green and gold paper. Predict, then cut one down the middle and one a third of the way in. Link the surprises into a garland.
how.hr: Napravite Möbiusove vrpce od crvenog, zelenog i zlatnog papira. Predvidite pa jednu prerežite po sredini, a drugu na trećini širine. Iznenađenja spojite u girlandu.

how.en: Cut out 3 paper presents in different sizes and stack them. Move the whole stack to Santa's sleigh one present at a time, never putting a big one on a small one. It takes 7 moves. Then try 4 presents!
how.hr: Izrežite 3 papirnata dara različitih veličina i složite ih jedan na drugi. Premjestite cijelu hrpu u Djedove saonice, jedan po jedan dar, a da veći nikad ne stavite na manji. Treba vam 7 poteza. Zatim probajte s 4 dara!

how.en: Bend a red-and-white pipe cleaner into a candy cane and hang it in strong sugar syrup. Then wait: new crystals grow on it every day.
how.hr: Savijte crveno-bijelu žicu za čišćenje lula u obliku štapa i objesite je u gusti šećerni sirup. Zatim čekajte: svaki dan na njoj narastu novi kristali.

how.en: Dye rice red, green and gold, then hide jingle bells, pinecones and cinnamon sticks in it. Shake the bin and listen: where are the bells?
how.hr: Obojite rižu u crveno, zeleno i zlatno pa u nju sakrijte praporce, šišarke i štapiće cimeta. Protresite kutiju i osluškujte: gdje su praporci?

how.en: Glue a small figure to a jar lid, fill the jar with water, glycerin and glitter, and close it tight. Shake it and watch the snow fall slowly.
how.hr: Zalijepite malu figuricu na poklopac staklenke, napunite staklenku vodom, glicerinom i šljokicama i čvrsto je zatvorite. Protresite je i gledajte kako snijeg polako pada.

how.en: Build the popsicle stick catapult and launch pom-pom snowballs at a paper-cup snowman. Which angle knocks him down?
how.hr: Napravite katapult od štapića za sladoled i ispaljujte grudve od pompona u snjegovića od papirnatih čaša. Pod kojim ga kutom srušite?

how.en: Make the lava lamp with white paint mixed into the water and a pinch of silver glitter. Drop in a piece of fizzing tablet and watch a blizzard swirl up and down.
how.hr: Napravite lava lampu, ali u vodu umiješajte bijelu boju i malo srebrnih šljokica. Ubacite komadić šumeće tablete i gledajte kako se mećava kovitla gore-dolje.

how.en: Make a cipher wheel, then write a coded clue telling someone where their present is hidden. Whisper them the key number.
how.hr: Napravite kotač za šifriranje pa napišite šifriranu poruku koja otkriva gdje je skriven nečiji dar. Ključ mu šapnite na uho.

how.en: Fold the origami house from brown paper and decorate it with white icing lines and paper sweets. Then fold a whole gingerbread village.
how.hr: Presavijte origami kućicu od smeđeg papira i ukrasite je bijelim linijama poput šećerne glazure i papirnatim bombonima. Zatim napravite cijelo selo.

title.hr: Ukras od perlica u binarnom kodu

how.en: Look up your name in binary code. Thread a red bead for every 1 and a white bead for every 0, then bend it into a ring for the tree. JOY needs 24 beads; how many does your name need?
how.hr: Pronađite svoje ime u binarnom kodu. Nanižite crvenu perlicu za svaku jedinicu i bijelu za svaku nulu pa ih savijte u prsten za bor. Za riječ MIR treba 24 perlice. Koliko ih treba za vaše ime?

how.en: Glue three cinnamon sticks into a reindeer face with antlers and hang it on the tree. Did you know that both male and female reindeer grow antlers?
how.hr: Zalijepite tri štapića cimeta u glavu soba s rogovima i objesite je na bor. Jeste li znali da rogove imaju i mužjaci i ženke sobova?

how.en: Collect pinecones on a walk and decorate them as tiny trees. Bonus: put one in a glass of water and watch it close up.
how.hr: U šetnji skupite šišarke i ukrasite ih kao mala drvca. Dodatak: jednu stavite u čašu vode i gledajte kako se zatvara.

how.en: Glue painted cardboard rolls into a tree: 6 in the bottom row and one fewer in every row above. How many rolls do you need in total?
how.hr: Zalijepite obojene kartonske role u oblik bora: 6 u donjem redu i jednu manje u svakom redu iznad. Koliko rola trebate ukupno?

how.en: Today is the winter solstice. Push a skewer through an orange, tilt it a little and walk it around a lamp. When the top half leans away from the light, it's winter up there.
how.hr: Danas je zimski solsticij. Probodite naranču štapićem za ražnjiće, malo je nagnite i nosite oko svjetiljke. Kad je gornja polovica nagnuta od svjetla, ondje je zima.

how.en: Build a potato battery, push the LED through a paper star and light up the top of your Christmas tree. How many potatoes does it take?
how.hr: Napravite bateriju od krumpira, provucite LED žaruljicu kroz papirnatu zvijezdu i upalite vrh svog božićnog drvca. Koliko krumpira treba?

how.en: Estimate how heavy Santa's sack is (number of presents × weight of one present), then find out what it would weigh on the Moon, Mars and Jupiter.
how.hr: Procijenite koliko je teška Djedova vreća (broj darova × težina jednog dara) pa provjerite koliko bi težila na Mjesecu, Marsu i Jupiteru.

how.en: On Christmas Eve 2026 the Moon is full. Look out of the window before bed: the Sun is lighting up the whole side that faces us.
how.hr: Na Badnjak 2026. Mjesec je pun. Pogledajte kroz prozor prije spavanja: Sunce obasjava cijelu stranu koja je okrenuta prema nama.
